d1_1: ^In the pre-trial investigation, you need to investigate the ghosts related to the case.
^The pre-trial investigation includes<color=red> three stages: inquiry, travel pass check, evidences addition</color>.
^Through this stage, you can learn more about the current case and the ghosts involved.
^Click on the <color=red>Start Inquiry</color> button, and enter the inquiry stage.
^After the inquiry, the ghosts will hand over their travel pass.
^You need to check whether the information on the traval pass is in accrod with the Book of Life and Death, and complete the Information Comparison Table.
^Finally, you need to ask the ghosts about the evidences. Please use the evidenc box on the top right side to show the evidence and make inquiry.
